entities.summary:
You Ruo (517 BCE - 457 BCE) was a philosopher or thinker of the Classical era, active in Global. He was known for his contributions to the fields of philosophy and thinkers. Born in unknown, his legacy extends to the ancient civilizations of Greece and Rome.

You Ruo's philosophical works explored the nature of reality, ethics, and human knowledge. His ideas had a significant impact on the development of Western philosophy, particularly in the areas of epistemology and metaphysics.

The legacy of You Ruo can be seen in the works of later philosophers, such as Aristotle and Plato. His ideas also influenced the development of Stoicism and Epicureanism.

One of the most enduring legacies of You Ruo is the concept of the 'examined life,' which emphasizes the importance of self-reflection and critical thinking.

This concept has had a lasting impact on Western philosophy and continues to influence contemporary thought.
